Voor een campagne, verkiezingen of een f: For a campaign, elections or a public holiday. With an end time the previous token set comes back by itself.
Leeg laten: de wissel blijft staan tot u: Leave empty: the switch stays until you reset it yourself.

De wissel zet de tokenset zoals u dat me: The switch sets the token set as you would by hand, with the matching Nextcloud logo and colours. At the end the token set, logo and colours from before the switch come back.
2 gepland, 1 mislukt. Een lopende wissel: 2 scheduled, 1 failed. A running switch sits at the top; a failed one shows the reason.
